name: Crystal Load Capacitor
blurb: load capacitors for a crystal from its CL and board stray capacitance
intro: A Pierce oscillator's two capacitors appear in series to the crystal, plus the board's stray capacitance: CL = C1·C2/(C1 + C2) + Cstray, so each capacitor is 2·(CL − Cstray). It also shows the frequency error of the standard value you fit and checks start-up margin (gm,crit) as in ST AN2867.

inputs.label: Crystal load capacitance CL
inputs.help: From the crystal datasheet, e.g. 6, 8, 9, 12, 12.5, 18, 20 pF.

inputs.label: Stray capacitance
inputs.help: Pins plus traces as the crystal sees them; 3–5 pF for a tight layout, 5–7 pF if unknown.

inputs.label: Crystal ESR (max)
inputs.help: Datasheet maximum: 30–100 Ω for MHz crystals, 50–90 kΩ for 32.768 kHz.

inputs.label: Motional capacitance C1 (optional)
inputs.help: For the ppm error of standard values; MHz AT-cut ≈ 5–20 fF, 32.768 kHz ≈ 2–3 fF.

inputs.label: Oscillator figure from MCU datasheet
inputs.help: Gm_crit_max (newer datasheets) or the oscillator's gm (older ones). 1 mA/V = 1000 µA/V; 32 kHz LSE figures are about 0.5–1.6 µA/V.

inputs.label: Fitted capacitor (optional)
inputs.help: A value you fit instead of the nearest standard one, e.g. 15; empty uses the nearest value of the series.

examples.title: 8 MHz HSE crystal, CL 12 pF, on an STM32
32.768 kHz watch crystal, CL 12.5 pF, LSE at high drive

usage: Give the crystal's CL in pF and the board stray capacitance in pF, the capacitor series, and for the start-up check the frequency in Hz, ESR in ohms, C0 in pF, optionally motional C1 in fF, and the MCU's Gm_crit_max or gm in µA/V (with gmode saying which); cfit in pF, if given, is the capacitor you fit instead of the nearest standard value. It returns the exact and standard load capacitor value, the CL actually obtained, the frequency error in ppm, gm,crit and the start-up margin. Use it whenever a crystal is placed next to a microcontroller or RTC.
sources: CL = C1·C2/(C1+C2) + Cs and gm,crit = 4·ESR·(2πF)²·(C0 + CL)² - ST AN2867 'Oscillator design guide for STM8AF/AL/S, STM32 MCUs and MPUs', sections 3 and 4
Load-pulling Δf/f = C1/(2·(C0 + CL)) - standard crystal equivalent-circuit result (e.g. Microchip AN826, IQD crystal handbook)
